At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. Nina advised Anna to try drawing as a new hobby. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The 2016 vintage sells out each spring.
The experience taught Anna more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Mum made chicken soup for lunch.

Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. This shop only sells genuine products.
Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Anna is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. Anna plans to study art harder this term. Best of all, the markup on glasses is huge.
Anna thanked Nina for the honest advice. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The online shop has become an important part of daily life.
